exclusions.source_text: Patients must be ≥18 years old or over the legal age of consent in their country
Women of childbearing potential (WOCBP) must be ready and able to use dual highly effective methods of birth control
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) score of 0 or 1
Previous or concomitant malignancies within the last 3 years, except certain effectively treated cancers
Significant and/or uncontrolled cardiovascular abnormalities, QT interval corrected for heart rate by Fridericia formula (QTcF) \>470 msec, or ejection fraction \<50%
